description: Simple power-map model: P_elec = eta * P_thermal * load_factor. No xenon dynamics or temperature feedback.

unit.name: Generic Molten Salt Reactor (MSRE/MSFR class)
unit.source: Haubenreich & Engel (1970) Nucl. Appl. Technol. 8(2):118; MacPherson (1985) Nucl. Sci. Eng. 90:374; NEA (2021) MSR Handbook
